data.title: About Bobir
bio: Bobir comes to us from Uzbekistan, and we are more than happy to have him.  He’s lived in the U. S.

since 2004 and is an accomplished engineer with a business acumen on par with some of the greats.  The skills he has acquired are vital in assisting handyman buyers or investors who need a second opinion on building layouts and infrastructures.  But don’t let that stop you, if you are interested in buying anything in general Bobir will be more than happy to help you find what is right for you.

He’s extremely familiar with the Marlboro, Matawan, Manalapan and Freehold areas, but will not restrict himself to those areas alone Bobir is a family man, he has a wife and two children, who he takes on camping trips in the summer.  He is an outdoorsman at heart, who loves biking and taking in the beauty of nature on hikes in his spare time.  It is this appreciation of the way things work, coupled with his technical knowledge and his profound ambition that will help you find the absolutely perfect home for you.
